summary: L3Harris Technologies filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $1.0 billion unsecured debt offering split evenly between $500 million 5.200% notes due November 5, 2029, and $500 million 5.400% notes due April 15, 2032. Public offering prices were 99.951% and 99.813%, respectively, for total gross proceeds of about $998.8 million and net proceeds of roughly $993.6 million after $5.25 million underwriting discount. Notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, rank pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, carry a change-of-control repurchase provision, settle T+3 on November 5, 2026, and will not be listed. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch rate spread and leverage metrics.
